The '''Mos Le'Harmless Cave''', also called the "Cave of Horrors", is found on [[Mos Le'Harmless]], which players can reach only after completing the [[Cabin Fever]] quest. The cave is the only place where [[Cave horror]]s and [[Albino bat]]s are found. The primary entrance is found on the beach on south side of the island ({{Map|type=maplink|mtype=pin|3748,2974}}). Alternatively, players with Level 82 [[Agility]]{{Boostable|yes}} can enter the cave using the entrance on the small island north of [[Trouble Brewing]].

A [[light source]] is required in the cave unless the player has lit a [[Fire of Eternal Light]] near the entrance. In the north-east, two staircases ascend to small islands with teak and mahogany trees and seaweed spawns.

The [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be used in the cave.
[[File:Mos Le'Harmless Cave entrance.png|thumb|270px|left|The entrance is found just east of the town by a small beach.]]

==Transportation==
The cave can be reached through a few methods:
* Teleporting to Trouble Brewing using the Trouble Brewing [[Minigame Teleport]] or [[Rum (red)|rum]] and running southwest (or north over the northern [[Stepping Stone (Mos Le'Harmless, level 82)|stepping stone]] with {{SCP|Agility|82}} Agility{{Boostable|yes}}).
* Travelling to Mos Le'Harmless' main settlement, running north through the northern entrance, then south-east through the forest. Players with {{SCP|Agility|60}} Agility can instead use the [[Stepping stone (Mos Le'Harmless)|stepping stone]] shortcut on the settlement's east side to cross the estuary.
** The settlement can be reached by using [[Mos le'harmless teleport|Mos Le'Harmless teleport scrolls]], taking a [[charter ship]], speaking to [[Bill Teach]] in [[Port Phasmatys]], or speaking to [[Brother Tranquility]] on [[Harmony Island]].

==Monsters==
*Level 80 [[Cave horror]]s (Level 58 [[Slayer]] and a [[Witchwood icon]] needed to fight). They are scattered around the cave and are aggressive.
*Level 52 [[Albino bat]]s. These are also aggressive, but rarely fought because they have no drops, and they mainly serve as an annoyance to players who wish to fight the horrors because they are aggressive.

==Personalities==
*[[Cavey Davey]] guards the entrance to the cave. He warns players to be prepared before entering.
[[File:Mos Le'Harmless Islands.png|thumb|262x262px|The two islands on the north-east coast of [[Mos Le'Harmless]], accessible through the cave. Each island features both a single [[teak]] and [[mahogany]] tree.]]

==Island==
A small set of islands can be accessed by running through the cave, to the north-east corner. The master clue step '''03 degrees 09 minutes south,''' '''43 degrees 26 minutes east''' takes players to the eastern island, and requires players to fight a [[Brassican Mage|Brassican mage]]. Traversing the cave can be bypassed using the northern [[Stepping Stone (Mos Le'Harmless, level 82)|stepping stone]] with {{SCP|Agility|82}} Agility{{Boostable|yes}}.

==Trivia==
[[File:Mos Le'Harmless Cave tiles.png|thumb|250px|Tiles with pictures resembling black masks on them.]]
*The music track Little Cave of Horrors is a reference to the film ''{{Wp|Little Shop of Horrors}}''.
*The black masks appear to be made of stone, with pieces carved away when compared to the markings littered on the floor around the dungeon.
*If a player wishes to enter the Mos Le'Harmless Cave without a [[Witchwood icon]], they may proceed by saying "Yes, I am not afraid to be killed in nasty ways", a reference to the song "Brave Sir Robin" from ''{{wp|Monty Python and the Holy Grail}}''.
*The swamp bubbles in the cave can be used to fill [[Ogre bellows]].
